calculation_rules.currency_conversion: Do not convert unidentified dollar currencies. Any later FX conversion requires its own dated source, rate direction and rounding basis.
calculation_rules.money: Use decimal arithmetic. Retain unrounded source-derived amounts and document final 0.01 AUD quantization. Missing prices prevent a complete purchased_vehicle_hardware_materials_cost result.
calculation_rules.units: Preserve source units. Convert gf to N explicitly using standard gravity; these are unit conversions, not new measurements.
calculation_rules.interpolation: Any interpolation must retain table identity, voltage, supported range and provenance. RPM, shaft torque and a 300-second thermal limit cannot be recovered from these tables alone.
calculation_rules.paired_model: Expose separate upper/lower thrust and torque interference parameters, geometry dependence and uncertainty. Solve collective demand and torque balance simultaneously, then evaluate differential-yaw headroom at that same operating point. Equal commands or equal RPM do not establish trim.
calculation_rules.electrical_model: Battery bus current is not motor phase current. Couple both propulsion channels and auxiliaries to loaded voltage. Distinguish assumed voltage scaling and loss models from vendor evidence; do not infer calibrated torque from battery current and KV alone.
calculation_rules.response_model: Motor/ESC lag, command slew, transport delay and loaded gimbal response remain separate uncalibrated parameters. The Skywalker manual acceleration settings in M2-02 are not measured first-order time constants.
calculation_rules.mission: Include spool-up, climb, acquisition, uninterrupted 300-second hover, descent, touchdown/settling and auxiliary conversion losses. One battery flies; charge the required whole two-battery purchase package. Reserve thresholds remain unapproved.
calculation_rules.mass: Final sizing must use complete CAD-reconciled installed mass, with commercial and density-based ownership counted once. Study allowances must remain labelled and cannot be described as measured CAD mass.
calculation_rules.integrated_branch: Leave unsupported CR28161100 thrust/torque performance unknown; do not transplant SunnySky curves or assign historical combined-thrust claims to this module.
